children: Seasoned corporate legal leader Debasmita Gupta has taken on a new leadership role as General Counsel at Orkla India. In her new capacity, Gupta will steer the legal, regulatory, governance, compliance, and secretarial functions to back the company's sustainable corporate growth strategy.
​Announcing her transition, Gupta emphasized her commitment to driving operational and governance excellence across the organization:

"I look forward to driving excellence across our Legal, Regulatory, Governance, Compliance and Secretarial functions to support sustainable corporate growth. Excited for this next chapter and collaborating with the fantastic team!"
